desc:
👶 A stork drops you into the world as a tiny baby... and then you wait in the funniest lines on Roblox!

🎢 Grow up line by line: baby checkup, ice cream truck, bouncy castle, school bus, lunch line, diving board, roller coaster, graduation, job interview, airport, airplane, car dealer, gym, barber shop, bingo night, cruise ship and the Hall of Fame!

🎂 Every life chapter ends with a birthday party and a NEW costume gift: Common to Mythic and DIVINE (0.02%)! Collect 55 costumes and 20 dream jobs.

😂 Prank the line: Cake Splat, Snowstorm, Scare All, Dodgeball Rain, Bonk, Party Horn, Tickle, Water Cannon and emojis!

⏩ Too slow? Skip the Line, Skip Time or Skip To Birthday.

👩‍⚕️ Be the Nurse, Lifeguard, Pilot, Captain, Mayor and more!

🎁 Daily rewards, playtime gifts and VIP.

👍 Like and favorite for new updates!
